description: This file is the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It initializes the React DOM, attaches the React app component to the DOM element with id 'root', and wraps the app in React.StrictMode for highlighting potential problems.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering a React component tree into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root container.
